name: Caves Road Boranup
_note: Caves Road (Tourist Drive 250) south of Margaret River through the Boranup karri forest: from near Mammoth and Lake caves, winding through the tall karri, to just south of where Boranup Drive rejoins near the Hamelin Bay end. Point to point, about 16 km, on the 30 m fallback heights. Sealed. Boranup Drive (the unsealed limestone scenic drive west of Caves Road, about 13.5 km, OSM way 31541578) is its own route: routes/boranup-drive.json, gravel along the OSM way. Pins stay away from its two junctions and Allan Road. No farm gates or mailboxes (farmRoadsides off): the tracks off this stretch are national park 4WD tracks, not driveways.

build._areaNote: Landmark patch: a small area joining the road to CaveWorks and the Lake Cave visitor centre, which stand just beyond the 70 m corridor, so they get detailed terrain (and the car park loop) to stand on instead of the horizon mesh, which sits about 3 m below the corridor ground there. streetsValid stays off so side streets along the road still count as off track, as without an area. Same as the Yallingup patch in routes/caves-road.json.
